# Completeness guard for resources/docs/bundle.json (the in-app documentation
# bundle generated by cmake/modules/BundleDocs.cmake). Reads the docs tree and
# the committed bundle straight from the source checkout, so a stale or
# incomplete snapshot fails here rather than shipping.
add_executable(docs_bundle_tests
    docs_bundle_tests.cpp
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/libslic3r/Markdown.cpp
)

target_include_directories(docs_bundle_tests PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
target_compile_definitions(docs_bundle_tests PRIVATE
    DOCS_BUNDLE_TEST_SOURCE_DIR=R"\(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}\)"
)
target_link_libraries(docs_bundle_tests test_common)
set_property(TARGET docs_bundle_tests PROPERTY FOLDER "tests")

add_test(docs_bundle_tests docs_bundle_tests "${CATCH_EXTRA_ARGS}")
